archetypes.name: ci-merge-semantics-reviewer
archetypes.rationale: The change touches two CI truth sources plus a retry loop guard.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review whether the plan fully unifies mergeable CI semantics between `gh.py`, `ship.py`, and existing `ci_monitor.py` behavior. Check that skipped, cancelled, neutral, and unknown JSON buckets cannot recreate the merge loop stall. Verify the repeated `CI_NOT_READY` guard cannot mask review-required or progressing CI states. Cite the plan section and repository path for every finding. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
